title: Penelope | Floral Button Blouse with Graceful Drape
bodyHtml:
This is the blouse you'll reach for constantly—soft, airy, and effortlessly flattering. The floral print catches the light beautifully, while the relaxed fit lets you move freely without a second thought. Wear it over everything, from weekend jeans to tailored trousers, and you'll look like you've made an effort when really you've just thrown on something comfortable.

Why you'll love it

  • Vibrant floral print that's fresh and eye-catching without being loud
  • Button V-neckline sits beautifully—just structured enough to feel polished
  • Short sleeves that breathe through warm days and cooler evenings alike
  • Soft, airy fabric with a natural drape that doesn't cling to your body
  • Relaxed, flowing shape that's genuinely comfortable for all-day wear
  • Pairs seamlessly with jeans, trousers, or skirts for endless styling
  • The kind of piece that feels like you but looks like you've thought it through

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
